property_summary: For any admissible call (exactly 10 ether, newer timestamp) executed at a block number divisible by 15, contract C must drain its entire balance to the caller (address(c).balance == 0); the mutant's inverted condition skips the payout on exactly such blocks, leaving a positive balance.
change_summary: Invert the block-number condition so the payout occurs on every block not divisible by 15.
